book.name: Timoteya
book.title: Elin̄olo lya Paulusi no weli kwa TIMOTEYA

content: Etitukelo no Alumeli
Olese okwayuta omukulu kono omususuweze kanyi sitowe, obabalele andumbana kanyi ainowe,
obabalele akulu no akati kanyi ainawowe, obabalele akatana kanyi amandowe mu kukena monje,
Okuteke akati no timbelwa awo atendile ambelwa luli.
Nji ombelwa kame ali naana simba aikulyaye, mwalesele akwiyete oweli oulapeli woo ku lubasi loo mi anjili mwause kwashemi oo, kakuli esi sokame eso silumelelwa mu miyo a Nyambe.
Cwale ombelwa no niti mi nasiyala yomboci mu umweya, mi kame atwalelela mu kukumbela ni kulapela omunji ni usiku.
Kono woyo okuyoyela mu minyaka, nafu naaba ayoya.
Walaele eyi, nji cwale aulwe naaba anyazahala.
Nji omunu yonje kababalele aabaye, onene asindoo yaye kame ana kana etumelo, mi kame abitiwa ku munu no kwapumena.
Etimbelwa
Ombelwa kame afanena okun̄oliwa mu buka no timbelwa nji nabitelele emyaka makumi atanu ni likumi limweya no kuleiwa. Woyo ona kukwaliwa ku mulume mumweya feela,

mi kame afanena okupakiwa wino ku misebezi yaye no kuwaba, oku lela aana, oku tambula angenda, oku yowisa amakondo no anu a Mbumu, okutusa aakalelwe, mane nukubeeka yonyene okutenda wino mu mikwa yonje.
Kono okane okun̄ola etimbelwa no akatana, kakuli aba akula mu minyaka kame atunda kwa Kilesite mane kame alakaza okukwaliwa,
mi kame akwingenyeka mu mubonda aba acola esepiso yoo no weli.
Kame akwiyeta okububa aba apota pota mu tindoo, mi kasa kububa feela kono ni kooba mane nikupateha etinyutu too, ni kwamba einu nambulwa tuso.
Cwale kame nisinga nji etimbelwa no akatana tikwaliwe, aleye aana, ababalele asitindoo too mane alese okuba esiila esibaka no kwamba eyi no kwiiba kwaaci.
Kakuli etimbelwa tinjili sebeli tafutukela kale kwa Satani.
Nji omuasi kupumena no mukati kame ali naabaye no timbelwa, aatuse, keleke ilese okwimelwa nji cwale keleke yonyene ituse etimbelwa nambulwa awo aatusa.
Aakulu no Keleke
Mulesele akulu awo aendisa wino, atenekiwe twiili onene awo sebeza mu kukutaza ni kwiyeta eliywi.
Kakuli elin̄olo kame lyamba nji, “Mulese okununga opulu kukanwa aba ashenga oubeke” mane, “Woyo osebeza kame afaneniwa omupuzo waye.”
Olese okutambula etaba eyi ilwisa omukulu no keleke, konji aba ibihiwa kwapaki ayiili simba aatu.
Kwawo atenda esiibi, waakalimele balubala no aanu onje nji cwale anjili acile.
Balubala lwa Nyambe ni lwa Kilesite Jesu mane ni balubala no man̄eloi aketilwe kame ni kulaela okumamela emilao eyi me ulwile esaluluti okutenda esinjili ni sobozi.
Olese okuleluba okubeeka amaoko baanu simba oukubeeka mu sibi no akowe, kono wene okukenise.
Olese okunwanga feela ameyi, kono okutusisange ni waine icana mulibaka no lipumo lyowe ni kukola-kola kowe no kulemenena.
Eibi no aanu anjili kame imonahala wino muwangu-wangu simba ba nako no katulo, kono eibi no anjili kame saimonahale munyima aba sakubite enako.
Cwale yongeeso ni ku misebezi no kuwaba kame imonahala, simba nji kaimonahala, kono kaitamba kusiyalela eishweekilwe.
